paper: How should a retrieval index chunk full-length scientific articles?
population_note: Unless a claim says otherwise: open-access PMC full-text articles on bacteria and viruses, Salesforce/SFR-Embedding-Mistral embeddings (4096-d), hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reciprocal-rank fusion and the BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder over the top 50, top 5 or top 10 read. OA-eval figures (section 5.4, 5.5) are over the 2,035-question decision set, one LLM-written question with an exact answer quote per article, quotes inside one section. Reach and single-passage figures (5.6, 5.7) are over the alias study's 1,091 term questions on 408 papers in four corpus collections. Older-study figures (5.1, 5.3) are over TREC CDS topics or Leg-B known-item queries on a 32,663-document PMC corpus. Every token count is in the SFR-Embedding-Mistral tokenizer unless marked chars/4. No two-reader human read has been performed anywhere in this record; the single-reader judge-validity figure is 0.872.

claims.statement: At a corpus of one document, where the document-level hit is 1.000 by arithmetic, the top-ranked 512-token chunk lands in the section the query was written from on only 0.6308 of queries: a document-to-passage gap of 0.3692 at k = 1, resolved against a power floor of 0.084.
claims.note: JUDGE-FREE: PH@k is chunk overlap with the gold section's byte offsets, no model label. n = 260 known-item queries (Leg B x0), one per document, each written from a deep section (0 of 260 from the abstract). Pre-registered family R1 (PREREG-rescore.md); 15 of 15 readings resolved. The gap vanishes at k = 10 (|Gap@10| <= 0.023): it is a top-1 precision phenomenon, and the two pre-registered k = 10 predictions failed and are reported as failures. Commit d225cea.

claims.statement: At 100 documents the same gap is 0.3385 at k = 1 (document hit 0.9462, passage hit 0.6077), resolved.
claims.note: JUDGE-FREE, n = 260, topical neighbours. Same family as `rescore-gap-k1-tok512-n1`.
